rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIridorio
Exhibition name: Gilbert Bécaud
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, before 1979).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1980 as 'Gilbert Bécaud'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, amber shading, carmine-pink edges. Mild fragrance. up to 45 petals. Very full (41+ petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Bronze-green foliage.

Height: 35" to 39" (90 to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
